quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei DOTI Micro Technology IR activity record: 2026-008 (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record; general manager, CFO): Faraday rotators come mainly from overseas, with Japanese makers among the main global suppliers; isolators are currently made mainly with overseas mainstream suppliers' rotators. The company has long-term cooperation with core upstream suppliers; purchasing and production scheduling are normal and operations have not been directly hurt by the policies so far. It hedges rotator price rises through long-term volume and price agreements and stocking, and does not grow rotator crystals itself, though a subsidiary slices, polishes and coats them. Some core customers set terms in mid- to long-term orders, but not all orders are price-locked.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei DOTI Micro Technology IR activity record: 2026-008 (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): isolator capacity is being expanded in phases with orders and equipment delivery as the Nanchang lines ramp; WDM filters and Z-Block assemblies are expanding in step at Nanchang to match high-speed module demand. Silicon lens assemblies for silicon photonics and next-generation high-speed modules are in customer sampling and small-batch validation, with small-batch deliveries at some customers; FAU products are in R&D sampling. For NPO and CPO, the company has set up dedicated joint development lines with customers and some products are in sample validation. Self-biased isolators can be produced but the material is scarce, so external-magnet isolators dominate.
